stem:
Read the following lines from the poem.

And if you try to push my mood swing, I'll only drag my feet.

The poet includes these lines most likely to suggest that the speaker —

options.label: F
options.text: does not wish to be pushed on a swing

options.label: G
options.text: wants to deal with the situation alone

options.label: H
options.text: does not often receive help from others
